title: WCCC — World Contribution Circulation Council
description:
An international standard proposal for AI safety, contribution circulation, and non-hegemonic AI governance.

Includes RECORD-LAYER.md: a two-layer ledger design in which the record layer registers who contributed what and when but generates no claims, while claims — where they exist at all — live in a separate settlement layer and must carry a declared terminus. Contains the withdrawal-invariance criterion (a transfer is a ladder only if the giver can withdraw without reducing the receiver's option set) and its four observable indicators: portability, reproducibility, exit symmetry, declared terminus.
